text:
maria: kicking off eu-2 region bring-up. scope: shared-network (tf), cluster pools (pulumi), and CI/state wiring. expecting GPU quota approval later today.
kevin: copying the runbook here, thanks. what's the immediate blocker?
sasha: quota is the big one. GCP returned a partial approval — CPUs ok but GPUs are throttled to 2 for now. ticket #4567.
maria: ugh. we need 16 v100s for the initial canary pool. can we use burst from another region temporarily?
ashok: you mean cross-region routing? that adds latency for KV cache. not great for ML perf.
kevin: alternative: reserve smaller canary with mixed instances (4 GPUs + 8 CPU-only nodes) and test autoscaler + fallback. cheaper and unblocks validation.
sasha: agree. will file a quick change to pulumi stack: use "canary-mixed" profile.
ci-bot: pulumi update preview started for stacks/eu-2/canary-mixed by sasha.
sasha: preview shows error on cloud-router peering step: "PeeringConflict: overlapping ranges".
maria: did we reuse the 10.40.0.0/16 range? Networking runbook said allocate new /20 per region.
ashok: looks like the shared-network terraform module allocated 10.40.0.0/20 already for dev-edges. need to reassign eu-2 to 10.41.0.0/20.
kevin: quick fix: terraform state mv module.shared_network.google_compute_subnetwork.eu2 module.shared_network.google_compute_subnetwork.eu2_repl; update var.region_cidr_map. but be careful with state locks.
ci-bot: terraform apply failed: Error locking state: NoSuchBucket: my-org-terraform-state not found in account.
maria: that explains CI failure. S3 bucket name changed after org move. CI creds are using old backend config.
kevin: updated pipeline secret to use terraform-backend-eu. rerunning init with: 
```
terraform init -backend-config="bucket=terraform-backend-eu" -reconfigure
```
sasha: init succeeded locally. plan looks clean after CIDR changes. pushing pulumi preview again.
ci-bot: pulumi update preview succeeded. cluster create looks good but ASG launch-template missing ssh key tag.
maria: add ops-deploy-key tag in the pulumi cluster module so we can debug nodes if needed.
ashok: noted. also adding a preemptible-profile to cost test: "spot-gpu-preemptible" for one pool. cost estimate: ~45% lower but higher churn.
kevin: reminder: create DynamoDB table for terraform locks if we're on AWS backend. but since we're using GCP bucket, enable GCS locking with a lock table replacement? GCS doesn't support locks natively.
sasha: we enabled Cloud Storage + a small redis-based lock service in infra for tf-locks. runbook step 4 covers it.
maria: runbook validation checklist (quick):
- [x] service account with roles (compute.admin, container.admin, networkadmin) created
- [x] billing enabled for project
- [x] CIDR allocated (10.41.0.0/20)
- [ ] GPU quota increased to 16 (ticket #4567)
- [x] terraform backend configured to terraform-backend-eu
- [x] pulumi secrets provider set to kms://projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/rdw/cryptoKeys/pulumi
- [x] CI pipeline canary gate configured (smoke tests + perf bench)

kevin: for handoff to oncall, add sequence to rollback to cpu-only pool: pulumi up with stack config overrides, or set feature flag in router to route non-critical traffic to hosted model.
sasha: adding explicit rollback snippet to runbook: 
```bash
# scale down GPU pool
pulumi config set cluster:gpu_enabled false --stack stacks/eu-2/canary-mixed
pulumi up --yes --stack stacks/eu-2/canary-mixed
```
maria: also include steps to revoke unnecessary IAM bindings after validation. we had an incident when service-accounts were too permissive.
ashok: cost note: initial projection for canary run (48h) ~ $1200 with mixed nodes, or $700 if preemptible GPUs used. logging these in the ticket.
ci-bot: smoke tests started (stability, key rotation, networking pings).
sasha: tests 1/3: control plane OK.
kevin: tests 2/3: node boot + kubelet OK, but GPU driver install failing on nodepool-2. error: "nvidia-driver-install: timeout".
maria: is the startup script pulling driver from mirror that blocks in eu? try the fallback URL: https://drivers-cache.internal/ubuntu/nvidia-latest.tar.gz
sasha: patched startupScript in pulumi module, reprovisioning nodepool-2.
ci-bot: nodepool-2 now passed GPU driver install. all smoke tests green.
maria: great. leaving follow-up items: open a small doc for cross-project VPC naming conventions, add quota escalation runbook snippet, and schedule handoff 1:1 with oncall tomorrow 10am CET.
kevin: thanks team — I'll take the handoff and create the onboarding checklist in Confluence. :thumbsup:
sasha: thanks all. tagging @ashok for any infra cleanup.
ashok: on it. will clear temporary peering and annotate state changes.
ci-bot: thread archived to infra-runbooks channel after 24h of inactivity.
